name: example-user-flow
title: User Flow Generator
description: Generate visual user flow sitemaps and whiteboard sketches using an LLM-guided web agent.

description_i18n.en: Generate visual user flow sitemaps and whiteboard sketches using an LLM-guided web agent.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 LLM 引导的 Web 代理生成用户流和白板草图。

query.en: Create a visual user flow whiteboard sitemap for: {{targetUrl}}. Goal: {{userGoal}}. Run the crawl_map_ai.py agent to explore the pages, capture screenshots, and lay out the whiteboard flow.
query.zh-CN: 为 {{targetUrl}} 创建用户流白板图。目标：{{userGoal}}。运行 user-flow 代理抓取相关页面并生成白板流。

inputs.name: userGoal
inputs.label: User Goal
inputs.default: Explore key pages and map user flow sitemap
inputs.placeholder: e.g. Find headphones, add to cart, and view checkout
